title: RaceChrono Lap Session Status Mix
dataSources: Garmin Zumo ride data (`garmin:zumo`), motorcycle OBD-II telemetry (`obd:bike`), RaceChrono laps (`racechrono:lap`), REVER rides (`rever:ride`), and RevZilla orders (`revzilla:order`).
app: Garmin Zumo ride exports, motorcycle OBD-II telemetry, RaceChrono track sessions, REVER ride logs, and RevZilla order history forwarded into Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=racechrono:lap
| eval status_value=lower(coalesce(lap_status,"unknown"))
| stats count as events by status_value
| sort - events
description: Breaks down the current mix of states reported by the RaceChrono lap session feed.
value: A status-mix panel provides quick at-a-glance context before you investigate specific outliers.
implementation: Map the source's `lap_status` values into a small set of clear labels and chart the resulting counts.
visualization: Donut or bar chart of event count by status.
grandmaExplanation: It nudges the overall mood of your RaceChrono lap session feed by counting how many events are healthy, warning, or bad.
